what: an R1 fillet on the end edge of a 3.5 mm slab after a pleated loft was joined flush with its inner face (the join needs a tool retry; later fillets must still work)
method: slab 120x3.5x95 with a 48 x 4.5 window, a pleated loft band joined flush into it, then R1 on the slab end edge at x=-60, 34 mm away from the join. The fillet edge is a plain straight convex edge between two large planar faces; the join must not leave slivers that make it fail. One closed valid solid is the right answer (the volume of the pleat band has no simple closed form).
